title: dinostomp item
description: One dataset item, after field mapping. One JSON object per JSONL line. An item carries its input inline (`input`) or by reference (`input_ref`); at least one is required.

id.description: Unique within the dataset. The linter enforces uniqueness.

input.description: Plain prompt string, or a chat message list. Optional only when `input_ref` carries the input instead, which is the case for a classification pod whose item IS an image.

target.description: Reference answer. A list means any listed answer is acceptable.

choices.description: Present only for multiple-choice items. The linter runs position and length bias checks when present.

input_ref.description: An input that lives in a FILE: an image, an audio clip. The dataset carries a POINTER, so the thing pointed at can change without the dataset changing; the declared sha256 is what closes that hole, and S12 re-hashes the bytes.

uri.description: Path RELATIVE to the pod directory. Absolute paths are refused: a pod is only portable if everything it needs travels with it.

sha256.description: The asset's bytes. Optional so a dataset can be built before it is pinned, and S12 says loudly when it is absent, because an unpinned asset is exactly the drift this project gates on everywhere else.

split.description: train / test / validation. Present, S14 checks that no asset appears in two of them, which is the leakage form vision benchmarks actually suffer from.
